title: AiDecisionCard input (v1.0.0)
description: Passed to AiDecisionCard.render(input, opts) as an object or a JSON string.

text.description: Plain string, or one string per language code.

bullets.description: Explanation bullets shown in a collapsible region. Omit to hide the toggle.

k.description: Stable machine key returned in the output. Never translated. '__other' is reserved.

id.description: Question key returned in the output.

b.description: Blocking: an answer is required. Default true.

c.description: Show the 'My own answer' option with a text field. Default true.

n.description: Show a per-question comment box. Default true.

id.description: Card id, echoed in the output.

lang.description: Display language code; 'en' and 'he' (RTL) built in. Default 'en'.

title.description: Optional; used by render.js as the page heading.

strings.description: Per-language UI string overrides or new languages (must include 'dir' for a new language).
